bio: Manideep Duggi is a Robotics & AI Engineer completing his M.S. in Robotics Engineering at Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI). He specializes in multi-robot systems, ROS2, computer vision, motion planning, and autonomous navigation.

skills.answer: Manideep's core skills include: ROS2, Python, C++, MATLAB, PyTorch, OpenCV, Linux, PCL, and MoveIt2. He has deep expertise in multi-robot motion planning, RGB-D perception, reinforcement learning, and embedded control systems.

experience.answer: Manideep has 4 key roles: (1) Research Assistant at WPI RoboCare Lab — built a Pepper + Stretch multi-robot assistive system, raising user task awareness from 15.8% to 84.6%. (2) Robotics & Automation Engineer at Virya Autonomous — led integration and debugging of 5+ AMR deployments. (3) Engineer, Smart Solutions R&D at Maini Materials — engineered AMR warehouse automation plans across 20+ sites. (4) Automation Engineer Trainee at Tranqvolt & Festo — built PLC systems and electro-pneumatic industrial solutions.

projects.answer: Manideep's notable projects include: RL-based robotic manipulation in the Genesis Simulator, AV lane-change controller, RGB-D grasping pipeline, ROS2 multi-robot coordination system, and deep learning-based object detection for assistive robots.

education.answer: Manideep is pursuing an M.S. in Robotics Engineering at Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI) with a GPA of 3.8/4.0 (Expected Dec 2025). His coursework includes Deep Learning for Robot Perception, Motion Planning & Kinematics, Foundations of Robotics (ROS2/C++), and Human Robot Interaction.

publications.answer: Manideep has a first-author publication: 'Enhancing Quality of Life for PWD through Context-Aware Assistive Robotics' (WPI RoboCare Lab, Spring 2025). It covers a multi-robot system using Pepper and Stretch robots, proving a 4x increase in user task awareness.
